Rapha Sydney Wednesday Open Ride

Sydney, Australia · Darlinghurst · Road

Rapha Sydney Wednesday Open Ride is a road group ride in Sydney, Australia. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 am local time from Taylor Square, Darlinghurst.

Next ride Wed, Oct 7, 6:00 AM GMT+11

How we know

Rapha's events page for the ride gives Wednesdays 6:00 am roll-out from Taylor Square, Sep to Dec 2026, open to non-members, and its booking page lists Wed Oct 7 to Nov 25, 2026 (read Oct 2, 2026).

For visitors

Members and non-members both welcome; book a place on Rapha's events site. Road bike and helmet. Rapha club members get 30% off coffee at Veneziano in Surry Hills after.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: seven groups, from conversational (23 km/h) to race pace (35 km/h+). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rapha Sydney Wednesday Open Ride group ride

Rapha Sydney calls this the city's largest weekly group ride. It rolls from Taylor Square at 6:00 am in seven pace groups.
